title: Chevening Scholarships
description: The UK government's global scholarship programme, funding a one-year master's degree at any UK university for emerging leaders from Chevening-eligible countries who have at least two years of work experience and demonstrated leadership potential.
amount: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, travel, arrival and departure allowances

title: Commonwealth Master's and PhD Scholarships
provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
description: Scholarships for students from low- and middle-income Commonwealth countries to undertake full-time master's or doctoral study in the UK, funded by the FCDO. Applications are made through a national nominating agency or selected university.
amount: Full tuition, airfare, monthly stipend, thesis and study-related allowances

title: GREAT Scholarships
provider: British Council and participating UK universities
description: Joint scholarships from the British Council's GREAT Britain Campaign and UK universities offering tuition support for one-year postgraduate courses to students from a defined list of countries. Each university runs its own application.
amount: At least GBP 10,000 towards tuition fees

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
description: Full-cost scholarship for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree (master's or PhD) at the University of Cambridge, selected on intellectual ability, leadership potential and commitment to improving the lives of others.
amount: Full tuition, maintenance allowance, airfare, and discretionary family and academic allowances

title: Rhodes Scholarship
description: The oldest international graduate scholarship, bringing exceptional young people from designated countries and regions to study at the University of Oxford. Selection considers academic excellence, character, leadership and commitment to service.
amount: Full tuition and college fees, annual stipend, airfare, settling-in allowance

title: Clarendon Fund Scholarships
description: Oxford's flagship graduate scholarship scheme, offering around 200 new awards each year to academically outstanding students from any country pursuing a full-time master's or doctoral course. Most applicants are considered automatically.
amount: Full tuition and college fees plus a generous annual living grant

deadlines.term: 2027 entry (deadline varies by course, Dec 2026 - Jan 2027)

title: Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme
field: All fields (eligible one- and two-year master's courses)
description: Fully funded scholarship combined with a leadership and public service programme, for outstanding graduates from developing and transition-economy countries who show potential and commitment to return home and lead positive change.
amount: Full tuition and college fees plus a living grant

title: University of Edinburgh Global Masters Scholarship
field: All fields (online and on-campus taught master's)
description: Tuition scholarships for international students accepting an offer for an eligible taught master's programme at Edinburgh, awarded on academic merit through a single application.
amount: GBP 5,000 to GBP 10,000 towards tuition fees

title: Marshall Scholarships
description: Prestigious scholarship funding young Americans of high ability to study for a graduate degree at any UK university, financed by the UK government as a gesture of thanks for Marshall Plan aid.
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, airfare, book and research grants
